clue.text: Give voice about frivolous disparagement

definitions.note: a verbal noun here: the act of belittling

indicators.note: about means the singing word goes round the outside of the frivolous word

parts.note: to give voice is to sing
light means frivolous, not serious

explanation.surface: Someone speaks up against idle, frivolous belittling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frivolous' looks like it describes the disparagement, but it gives the inner word, and 'about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Slighting someone is treating them with contempt, a form of belittlement.

clue.text: A twit backed up-given his head? That's rough on one

indicators.note: in a down answer, backed up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a fool is a twit

indicators.note: his head is the first letter of the word his

explanation.surface: A silly person stands back with his head given free rein; that is tough on someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed up' reverses A FOOL to LOOFA, and 'head' takes H from 'his'.
explanation.definitionFit: A loofah is a coarse dried sponge-gourd, scratchy against the skin when scrubbing oneself.

clue.text: Garrulous individual, the airship maker!

definitions.meaning: a person who talks too much
the gas-filled bag that gives an airship its lift

explanation.surface: A chatterbox is dismissed as the builder of airships.
explanation.definitionFit: A windbag talks endlessly, and the gas-filled envelope is the component that makes an airship float.

clue.text: SE European land bird

definitions.meaning: a country in the south-east of Europe, partly in Asia
a large fowl eaten at Christmas

explanation.surface: A bird native to a south-east European country.
explanation.definitionFit: The country straddles south-east Europe and Asia, and the same name is the big farmyard fowl.

clue.text: They're very sharp — use their eyes!

definitions.text: They're very sharp — use their eyes!

parts.words: They're very sharp — use their eyes!
parts.note: sounds like keen-sighted people, but describes pointed sewing tools threaded through a small hole called an eye

explanation.definitionFit: Sewing needles are sharp-pointed and threaded through an eye at the top.

clue.text: Dealers caught over trainers

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
handlers train and manage animals

explanation.surface: Dealers are caught out by their coaches.
explanation.definitionFit: A chandler is a dealer or merchant, especially in candles or ship's supplies.

clue.text: Day-dream fancifully about the Orient when all is prepared

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the eastern letter
fancifully means the letters of day-dream are imaginatively rearranged

parts.note: E is east, the Orient

explanation.surface: Someone daydreams about the East once everything is ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancifully' rearranges DAYDREAM and 'about' wraps it round E; 'when all is' is link material.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prepared is made ready for use, set up in advance.

clue.text: Beaten, even though there in first place

indicators.note: in means the word there sits inside the first-place word

parts.note: the lead is first place in a race

explanation.surface: Someone was beaten, even though they were in the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'even though' is only link material joining definition and wordplay; LEATHERED is British slang for thrashed.
explanation.definitionFit: Leathered is informal British slang for thrashed, as with a leather strap.

clue.text: Sort of car seen in the Aegean area

indicators.note: a sort of something is a variant version, so these letters are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: A particular type of motor is spotted around the Greek islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort of' rearranges CAR and THE together; 'seen in' just links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrace is an ancient region bordering the northern Aegean Sea, now split between Greece, Bulgaria and Turkey.

clue.text: Is not lavish with the jam

definitions.meaning: to use something sparingly, to save it
fruit preserves; plural in the answer against a singular here, as whole-fruit jams

explanation.surface: Someone is sparing with the jam at breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: To conserve is to economise on something, and conserves are preserved fruit like jam.

clue.text: 23 perhaps joining popular party

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 23 across, an example of this creature

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
a sect is a faction or party

explanation.surface: Someone numbered 23 joins a popular political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 23 is EARWIG, one example of the class of creature.
explanation.definitionFit: An earwig is one example of a six-legged creepy-crawly of that class.

clue.text: Game beauty carrying a gun

indicators.note: carrying means the beauty word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is old American slang for a pistol

explanation.surface: An armed beauty queen brings a gun along.
explanation.walkthrough: GAT is dated American gangster slang for a gun; 'Game' looks like an adjective (willing) but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Bagatelle is a table game where balls are struck into holes guarded by pins.

clue.text: Maintain a member in drink

indicators.note: in means the limb word is placed within the drink word

parts.note: ale is beer, a drink
a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A leg is said to be steeped in alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' is the usual crossword word for a limb; the opening 'a' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To allege is to assert or claim something, to maintain it is true.

clue.text: Negotiating a rise, vets appear quite confident

indicators.note: negotiating suggests working something into a new shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Vets seem self-assured when bargaining for a pay increase.
explanation.definitionFit: Assertive means forceful and self-assured, confident in stating views.

clue.text: Erica is always concerned for the environment

definitions.note: a noun: the heather genus, here standing for a plant that keeps its leaves

parts.note: ever means always
green means environmentally conscious

explanation.surface: A woman called Erica is always eco-minded.
explanation.walkthrough: Erica looks like a woman's name but is the botanical genus of heathers.
explanation.definitionFit: Heathers of the genus Erica keep their foliage year-round, so they are an example of such a plant.

clue.text: Skilled man making a terrific crack

indicators.note: to crack something is to break it apart, so these letters are broken up and reordered

explanation.surface: A craftsman makes a superb attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificer is a skilled craftsman or mechanic.

clue.text: A beast taking dope

definitions.meaning: a donkey, a beast of burden

explanation.surface: An animal is given drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey is a beast of burden, and a fool or idiot is also called by this name.

clue.text: A mountain in central Pakistan

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words central Pakistan

explanation.surface: A peak located in the middle of Pakistan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'central' tempts a middle-letters pick, but the letters run across 'central Pakistan'.
explanation.definitionFit: An alp is a high mountain, especially in Switzerland.

clue.text: Utter stuff!

explanation.surface: Total nonsense!
explanation.definitionFit: To utter is to speak, and say is also an old fine serge-like fabric, a kind of stuff.

clue.text: Not many will be cut by a pound

parts.note: to sever is to cut
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Few people will see their wages reduced by a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means more than two but still a modest number, a few.

clue.text: Summarise article on flyover

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
a flyover is a road bridge over another road

explanation.surface: Write a short piece on a new road flyover.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten it, condensing it into a summary.

clue.text: Spend money indeed!

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for penny, a coin of money
ay is an old spelling of aye, yes indeed

explanation.surface: An exclamation urging someone to part with cash.
explanation.walkthrough: P stands for a penny, the smallest British coin.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay out is to hand over money, to spend it.

clue.text: A hold-up a worker finds awfully hard

parts.note: a dam holds water up
an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: A labourer finds a delay extremely difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamant originally named a legendary hard substance and now means unyielding, inflexibly firm.

clue.text: A six-footer from somewhere near Wigan

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of the words near Wigan

explanation.surface: A very tall person comes from a place close to Wigan, a town in north-west England.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'six-footer' sounds like a tall man, but means a creature with six feet, an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: An earwig is an insect, and every insect has six legs, so it is literally six-footed.

clue.text: Many prate agitatedly, being downtrodden

definitions.note: a noun phrase: the thing walked over underfoot

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many

indicators.note: agitatedly means the letters of prate are stirred up

explanation.surface: Many talk nervously about being oppressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' is a standard crossword signal for C, the Roman hundred; 'agitatedly' is the anagram signal on 'prate'.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor covering is constantly walked on, trodden down underfoot.

clue.text: Correct about fashion

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to form is to fashion or shape

explanation.surface: Put right something concerning fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: To reform is to amend or improve, to put right.

clue.text: Within this a fellow has to exercise control

parts.note: he refers to a male, a fellow
to rein is to restrain or exercise control

explanation.surface: Inside, a man must keep things in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Herein is a formal word meaning in this document or place.

clue.text: Limitation that's normal with a measuring device

parts.note: par is the normal or standard level
a meter is an instrument that measures

explanation.surface: A gauge with a normal reading sets a limit.
explanation.definitionFit: A parameter is a boundary or limit within which something must operate.

clue.text: A criminal Greek character in a spin

indicators.note: in means the Greek letter sits within the spin word

parts.note: a turn is a spin
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek crook is in a flat spin.
explanation.walkthrough: Dick Turpin was a notorious 18th-century English highwayman.
explanation.definitionFit: Dick Turpin was a famous English highwayman and horse thief, hanged in 1739.

clue.text: The Parisienne upset poor men as a satirist

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the

indicators.note: upset means the letters of poor men are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A Parisian woman offends poor men by mocking them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges POOR MEN to MPOONER, which follows LA, French for 'the' with a feminine noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A lampoon is a satirical attack, so one who writes them ridicules people in print.

clue.text: Saw and contended about one point after another

indicators.note: about means the contending word is wrapped round the compass points

parts.note: vied means competed, contended

indicators.note: after means the first point is placed following the other one

parts.note: W, west, is another compass point
E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: Someone watched and argued over one point after another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts WE inside VIED; 'after' puts E following W.
explanation.definitionFit: Viewed is the past tense of view, meaning looked at, just as saw is of see.

clue.text: Account for alteration to testament

indicators.note: an alteration to a will changes it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lawyer explains why a will was amended.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a written or spoken account of events.
